task: Choice only, with identical state distractors retained
reproduction_control_task: Multitask stream training, 4000 steps, common NumPy/Python; evaluated on legacy test seed 5002
numerical_control: Current code with the original sigmoid expression for BCE gradients; isolates this numerical change

generator_control.fixed_q: q(n)=0.7; likelihood ratio depends on option count

context_control.count: Original mask; true option count indexes an embedding in the question block
context_control.random_count: Original mask; independent uniform context index in 2..6
context_control.set: Question tokens read all options of their own question; option tokens retain their own local block and read pooled context through the question; zero context vector
context_control.active_context_rows: count/random_count activate rows 2..6; isolated/set use fixed zero context
context_control.initial_context_embeddings: all zero; shared base parameters identical within each seed

analysis_rules: Report every condition and every seed, including failed runs.
Verify matching training-data and initial-parameter hashes within each world/seed block.
Primary results use raw logits; temperature is fitted only on the validation split.
Report per-seed results and mean/standard deviation; test items are not independent training replicates.
Do not generalize this synthetic Choice study to Jev, RLCD or general language performance.
Do not select hyperparameters or stop training based on the test results.
